identity.zh-CN: TraceFold Windows 照片与视频整理工具
identity.en: TraceFold Windows photo and video organizer

documentationIdentity.rule: The documentation ref is selected and recorded separately when public release material is prepared; it is not inferred from or substituted for productSourceCommit.

capabilities.summary: Local desktop organization of photos and ordinary videos.
Preview inbox photos and ordinary videos after configuring Inbox, Library and Work directories.
Pair matching MP4 and M4A inputs, preprocess them, and explicitly commit the result; this is not standalone music playback.
Maintain display names, authors, series and content tags; display names remain separate from filenames on disk.
Search by filename or display name and filter through existing author, series and tag flows.
Compare detected conflicts and choose the documented skip, keep-both or replace flow.
The documented product workflow uses local directories and does not require configuring a cloud service or online account first.
The published product package includes .NET, Windows App SDK runtime components, FFmpeg and FFprobe.

notShipped.summary: No public API, CLI or MCP surface is declared for third-party control of the desktop application.
PDF, EPUB, comic reading, and standalone music-file ingestion, playback, or music-library management are not part of the current release.
Multiple media spaces and multi-instance workflows are not part of the current release.
OCR, audio transcription, face matching and automatic tagging are not part of the current release.
Missing-library-record hiding and stale-record removal are not part of the current release.
The UI acceptance toolkit is not the ordinary-user product entry point.

verification.interpretation: Plans, source-only changes and unpublished development candidates are not shipped capabilities.
